claim_text: The Lincoln has spent a record-setting uninterrupted period of more than 240 days at sea, against a normal U.S. military vessel deployment of about six months, CBS News reported on 16 August 2026.
quote: It has spent a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea of more than 240 days.
confidence_justification: Reported figure; the cluster carries competing day counts (240, 250, 260), so slightly below ceiling.
